# Kinetic Icons (`kinetic-ui-icons`)

> Kinetic Icons is a free, open-source (MIT) library of 178 original, round-corner-friendly monoline SVG icons crafted on a 24x24 optical grid. Unlike static icon sets that distort when rounded, Kinetic computes continuous-curvature cubic Bezier corners dynamically across stroke weight (0.75px–3.5px), corner radius (0.0px sharp to 4.0px soft), and color.

## Quick Facts
- **Website**: https://kinetic.framesbyneer.in/
- **Creator**: Neer (https://framesbyneer.in)
- **npm Package**: `kinetic-ui-icons` (`npm install kinetic-ui-icons`)
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/neerxj789/kinetic-icons
- **License & Pricing**: MIT License — $0, free forever for personal and commercial projects (no attribution required)
- **Catalog Size**: 178 original icons across 9 categories (Essentials, Design, Navigation, Social, Brands, Actions, Dashboard, Dev & AI, Alerts)
- **Frameworks Supported**: React 17/18/19, Next.js App Router (Server Components compatible, zero `'use client'`), Vanilla JS / HTML / Vue / Svelte / Astro (`<kinetic-icon>` Web Component), Zero-Dependency TypeScript Core (Node/Edge/SSR), and Flutter (`flutter_svg` via `kinetic_icons.dart`).
- **Color Support**: Defaults to `stroke="currentColor"` (inherits Tailwind/CSS text color or Flutter `IconTheme`) and also supports explicit `color` props/attributes (`#2563EB`, RGB, CSS variables, Flutter `Color`).

## Documentation & Resources
- [Complete LLM Technical Reference & Full 178-Icon Catalog](https://kinetic.framesbyneer.in/llms-full.txt): Full API specs, framework code snippets, and every official icon ID.
- [Interactive Documentation](https://kinetic.framesbyneer.in/?page=docs): Installation, live color preview, props reference, and copyable AI Agent Prompt.
- [Interactive Icon Studio](https://kinetic.framesbyneer.in/?page=studio): Search all 178 icons, tune stroke weight & corner radius live, inspect SVG/React/Web/Flutter code, and download ZIP bundles.
- [Pricing & License](https://kinetic.framesbyneer.in/?page=pricing): $0 MIT open-source license details and optional creator support.
- [npm Registry](https://www.npmjs.com/package/kinetic-ui-icons): Official npm package with ESM, CJS, and TypeScript declarations.
- [Source Code](https://github.com/neerxj789/kinetic-icons): Open-source repository on GitHub.

## Quick Usage

### React / Next.js (Server Components)
```tsx
import { Home, ShieldCheck, Cloud, Verified } from 'kinetic-ui-icons/react';

<Home size={24} strokeWidth={1.5} radius={2.5} />
<ShieldCheck size={24} className="text-blue-600" />
<Verified size={24} color="#2563EB" />
```

### Vanilla JS / HTML / CDN
```html
<kinetic-icon name="home" size="24" stroke="1.5" radius="2.5"></kinetic-icon>
<script type="module">
  import 'https://esm.sh/kinetic-ui-icons/web';
</script>
```

### Zero-Dependency Core (Node / Edge / SSR)
```ts
import { homeIcon, renderIconSvg } from 'kinetic-ui-icons/core';
const svg = renderIconSvg(homeIcon, { size: 24, stroke: 1.5, radius: 2.5, color: '#111113' });
```
